description: This is a Flutter application main file that sets up the app with a simple UI indicating that the 'todo_frontend_app' is being generated. It contains the main app widget, a home page widget, and UI elements like AppBar, Text, and CircularProgressIndicator.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app, setting up MaterialApp with theme and home page.

classes.name: MyHomePage
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the main screen of the app with a title parameter.

classes.name: _MyHomePageState
classes.description: State class for MyHomePage, builds the Scaffold layout with app bar and centered content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the Flutter application, calls runApp with MyApp instance.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for MyApp and _MyHomePageState, setting up MaterialApp and Scaffold respectively.
